import sys

class ListNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
        self.val = val
        self.next = next

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        print()
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    vals = list(map(int, data[1:1 + n]))
    head = cur = ListNode()
    for v in vals:
        cur.next = ListNode(v)
        cur = cur.next
    head = head.next
    prev = None
    while head:
        nxt = head.next
        head.next = prev
        prev = head
        head = nxt
    out = []
    while prev:
        out.append(str(prev.val))
        prev = prev.next
    print(' '.join(out))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def inorderTraversal(root):
    out = []
    def dfs(node):
        if not node:
            return
        dfs(node.left)
        out.append(node.val)
        dfs(node.right)
    dfs(root)
    return out

import sys

class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right

def build(arr):
    if not arr or arr[0] == 'null':
        return None
    root = TreeNode(int(arr[0]))
    q = [root]
    i = 1
    while q and i < len(arr):
        cur = q.pop(0)
        if i < len(arr) and arr[i] != 'null':
            cur.left = TreeNode(int(arr[i]))
            q.append(cur.left)
        i += 1
        if i < len(arr) and arr[i] != 'null':
            cur.right = TreeNode(int(arr[i]))
            q.append(cur.right)
        i += 1
    return root

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        print()
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    arr = data[1:1 + n]
    root = build(arr)
    out = []
    def dfs(node):
        if not node:
            return
        dfs(node.left)
        out.append(str(node.val))
        dfs(node.right)
    dfs(root)
    print(' '.join(out))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
